name: Environment context environment indicator
description: Automatically registers every Environment Indicator entity as an available environment in Environment Context.
project_description: A submodule of Environment Context. When enabled it subscribes to Environment Context's AvailableEnvironmentsEvent and adds every Environment Indicator config entity (loaded via entity_type.manager storage 'environment_indicator') as an available environment, using the entity id as the machine name and the entity label. It has no UI and provides no configuration; it only makes existing Environment Indicator entities appear as selectable environments (for example in the 'Current environment' condition). It does not change how the active environment is detected.
